description: Plagueheart Belt Level 60 Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Plagueheart Belt if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Belt, 8 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Arcane Crystals and 2 Mooncloth. Requirements: - Desecrated Belt - Wartorn Cloth Scrap x 8 - Arcane Crystal x 2 - Mooncloth x 2
name: Plagueheart Belt
